summary: No independent wound segmentation dataset with >=80 expert image/mask pairs was reachable via github.com or PyPI. Nothing installed.

duplicate_check_method.coarse: 24x24 grayscale zero-mean unit-norm NCC; candidate full image, horizontal flip, and 3x3 grid crops at 0.75/0.5 scale plus square centre crop, vs reference full images and reference grid crops
duplicate_check_method.verify: SIFT (800 features, image max side 384) + RANSAC partial-affine inliers against top-5 coarse matches per reference set; duplicate if inliers >= 25
duplicate_check_method.calibration: unrelated reference pairs (Medetec vs FUSeg/AZH): max 17 inliers; known duplicates (Medetec test vs train, FUSeg vs AZH): 42-452 inliers. NCC alone is not discriminative (unrelated wound photos reach 0.93-0.96 NCC with crop search).

rejected.reason: Same clinic as FUSeg/AZH (AZH Wound Center, Milwaukee) per its README; 110 labelled tissue images; also image-level overlap found
Only 13 of 147 images published on GitHub; images drawn from the DFU database and Medetec per the paper (arXiv 2502.10652); tissue-class masks
Pressure ulcer photos; only 21 test images have an expert binary ground truth; the 84 training images carry only GrabCut/SVM algorithm outputs and partial superpixel labels

azh.note: the single 27-inlier hit was inspected visually and is spurious
